supplementaryReferences.quote: The flesh of the bitter karkoer or bitterboela is not used by humans
supplementaryReferences.note: The catalogue entry combines tsamma and var. citroides/landrace labels. SANBI distinguishes edible makataan/tsamma forms from bitter karkoer; identity and edible part must be confirmed.

productionGuidance.products: identified edible melon landrace — specialist confirmation needed
care: Keep this mixed landrace entry out of household-food totals until an experienced local grower confirms the seed source, form and appropriate food preparation.
The source describes a sprawling annual for fairly dry areas with adequate space.
purchase: Obtain an identified edible food landrace from a trusted local seed source. A wild-looking melon or the common name karkoer alone is insufficient.
